name: reading-buddy-expert
description: A local-first WeRead reading companion that organizes shelves, notes, cards, reviews, and public reader discoveries.

displayDescription.zh: 贴一段摘录，聊聊为什么划下它。用共读书签记住你的问题和判断，下次接着读，也能从笔记里选论点，写出有出处的书评。
displayDescription.en: Start with a passage, save your question and interpretation locally, and pick up the discussion next time. Compare interpretations and turn selected notes into a sourced book review.
